svg.title: OpenBridge interoperability demo
svg.desc: Animated demo: phones, a tablet, a laptop, a watch, a VR headset, a fridge and smart glasses gain new skills and drive lights, a coffee machine, a smart plug, a TV, another phone, a desktop PC and another VR headset. Devices also talk to each other directly. The VR headset generates a control room for every device, and smart glasses show live battery, distance, CPU and RAM tags over each device.

g.text: The watch never had a coffee button. OpenBridge just created one.
Device to device, no phone in between: the machine taps your wrist.
Two brands, two protocols, one scene. Lights dim, the TV wakes up.
The TV drives the lights on its own. Colors track every scene.
Milk is running low: the list lands on the other phone in the house.
The PC finishes its job and cuts the plug by itself.
Drop a file on any PC
Android to Linux over the local network. No cable, no cloud.
Different brands, one shared space, synced in real time.
OpenBridge built a VR control room for 12 devices. One pinch each.
Battery, distance, CPU and RAM, floating over every device.
THROUGH THE GLASSES · SAME HUD IN VR
Every device, in your field of view
14 devices · 8 live links · 6 protocols · zero cloud
